title: Fuutu Stack Docs
subtitle: Production-grade documentation powered by Fumadocs
description: A ready-to-use documentation template that ships with the Fuutu Stack. Built with Fumadocs, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Every Fumadocs feature is showcased as a modifiable example.
metaDescription: A ready-to-use documentation template with Fumadocs, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS. Full i18n, OpenAPI docs, search, and dark mode out of the box.
